extension.description: Shows the manual that came with a game, from the game's own folder, and finds one for a game that has none through add-ons that know where manuals are. Pages can be zoomed and panned, and each manual reopens where it was left.
extension.news: v0.1.1 (2026-10-03)[CR]- Sharper pages, a manual already on disk is used before downloading one, and Kodi no longer reports an object left over when the script ends.[CR][CR]v0.1.0 (2026-10-02)[CR]- First release: shows a game's manual, and finds one through manual providers.
